Card Q&A.q: If this Digimon is suspended, can it itself become the target when its [Opponent's Turn] effect switches the target of an opponent's Digimon's attack?

Card Q&A.a: They trigger simultaneously, so the turn player can activate their [When Attacking] effect first.
Card Q&A.q: When one of my opponent's Digimon attacks, in what order do that Digimon's [When Attacking] effect and this card's [Opponent's Turn] effect activate?
